source: Yahoo Finance daily bars (chart API; yfinance fallback). Price returns, not total return.

method.returns: Last close vs last close on/before the same calendar date N periods earlier; YTD vs prior year-end close; n/a if history is shorter.
method.volume: Last session volume vs average of the N sessions before it.
method.ma: Simple moving average of daily closes incl. the latest bar; % = price / MA - 1.
method.futures: Continuous front-month futures: long-horizon returns (esp. 10Y) include roll effects.

sections.label: Strategic peers
sections.note: Speculative, illustrative screen of listed strategic and financial investors active in European renewables. Not based on any reported approach; not investment advice. Hover a name for the rationale.

rows.name: Fortum
rows.note: Nordic hydro/nuclear utility (Finnish state ~51%); strategy targets growth in Nordic onshore wind/solar, strong balance sheet.

rows.name: Equinor
rows.note: Norwegian state-controlled major with a power/renewables arm; has bought onshore platforms before (BeGreen, Wento) and holds ~10% of Ørsted.

rows.name: Aker ASA
rows.note: Oslo-based industrial holding with a renewables history (Aker Horizons / Mainstream); natural home-market consolidator.

rows.name: Bonheur
rows.note: Parent of Fred. Olsen Renewables, operating onshore wind in Norway, Sweden and the UK; direct Nordic onshore fit.

rows.name: Verbund
rows.note: Hydro-heavy Austrian utility (state ~51%) expanding renewables abroad; Nordic hydro/wind would diversify its base.

rows.name: TotalEnergies
rows.note: Integrated Power growth ambition; has bought renewables developers/platforms (e.g. Total Eren, VSB).

rows.name: RWE
rows.note: Large-scale European renewables/generation player; Nordic onshore would be a bolt-on (lower priority vs offshore/US).

rows.name: Brookfield Renewable
rows.note: Serial acquirer of listed renewables platforms, incl. European take-privates (e.g. Neoen with Temasek).

rows.name: EQT AB
rows.note: Nordic private-markets manager whose infrastructure funds took Swedish developer OX2 private (2024).

rows.name: KKR
rows.note: Infrastructure funds active in European renewables take-privates (Encavis, Greenvolt in 2024).

rows.name: NGEx Minerals
rows.note: Valle Ancho spin-out (Valiente Resources) pending Q4 2026: expect a price discontinuity.

rows.name: LunR Royalties
rows.note: Listed ~Jan 2026: short history. Not the Nasdaq 'LUNR' (Intuitive Machines).

rows.name: ShaMaran Petroleum
rows.note: Euronext Growth Oslo since Jun 2026: short Yahoo history.

rows.name: EU carbon (EUA ETC)
rows.note: SparkChange physical EUA ETC: thin volume.
